Aloha,

I am reaching out to kindly request assistance with cleaning up a strip of City & County-owned land located between my home at 216 Kuliouou Road and the Kuliouou Canal.

I would first like to express my appreciation to the City crews who have come out to cut the grass and maintain the surrounding areas. I am truly thankful for the work that has been done.

However, there is a section directly adjacent to my property that appears to be consistently missed during routine maintenance. Over time, a significant amount of fallen palm fronds and dried vegetation has accumulated, and the area has become increasingly overgrown.

I am a new resident of this home, and I understand that the previous occupants may not have brought this concern to the City’s attention. However, as a family with young children who enjoy playing outdoors, I am becoming increasingly concerned about the condition of this area.

I have already noticed an increase in rodent activity, and I worry that the accumulated palm fronds and overgrown vegetation are creating an ideal environment for rodents, centipedes, and mosquitoes. With my children frequently playing outside, this has become a health and safety concern for my family.

I would greatly appreciate it if someone from the appropriate department could come out to assess the area and arrange for the removal of the accumulated palm fronds and overgrown vegetation. If possible, I would also kindly ask that this particular section be included in future routine maintenance so that the issue does not continue.

I understand that the City has many areas to maintain, and I truly appreciate the hard work of the crews who care for our community. My hope is simply to have this area properly maintained so that my family and our neighbors can enjoy a cleaner and safer environment.

Thank you so much for your time, consideration, and assistance. I look forward to hearing from you.

Mahalo!
